fact: The CNT reported that on 20 June 2024 its commissions debated a bill to establish the Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel, an authority the 2016 cybersecurity and personal data protection law provides for, with members' designation and mandates still contested and plenary adoption pending.

ANSSI's summary states Loi L/2016/037/AN on cybersecurity and personal data protection was adopted by the National Assembly and promulgated by President Alpha Condé, covering personal data processing by individuals, companies and public institutions; it gives no commencement statement and dates the law to 2016 only (document published 2016, year precision).

The National Assembly's text of Law L/2016/037/AN on cybersecurity and the protection of personal data carries the promulgation formula, with the law number and date left blank, and Part Two is a full personal data protection regime; it states no commencement date, and the record is dated only to July 2016 (document published date, month precision).
